stage: Gravitational-lens wormhole for the War Zone / Colonization branch change
status: Built and checked locally; author playtest pending; not deployed
machine: Author's Windows workstation, Chrome 155.0.8059.86, ANGLE D3D11 on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (WebGL2 available headless)

rotationHandoff.note: Live destination layer uploads to WebGL during expansion, and the sphere raster at the last lens frame against the first live frame

wholeScreenHandoff.method: Mean absolute RGB difference (0-255 levels) of the full canvas: last frame before the effect vs its first frame, and last lens frame vs first live frame, each compared with an ordinary consecutive-frame step. Measured with per-frame getImageData, which slows frames; two repeated runs agreed.
wholeScreenHandoff.start: 0.000-0.004 at the start in every case (exact to rounding)
wholeScreenHandoff.reading: The residual mean sits in the sun's gradient region at under 8 levels; pixels changing by more than 8 levels are as few as an ordinary frame step on desktop and a few hundred on the phone. Not yet judged by the author.

fixtures: Disposable accounts and temporary DATA_DIR worlds only; no developer save was opened, changed or reset.
